verdict.rationale: Sentry's alerts docs state that an alert rule can call webhooks, so alert notifications can be routed to an HTTP endpoint that could drive remediation or an agent. Beyond that one-line claim, the webhook mechanism is undocumented in the pack, and nothing shows it being used to trigger automation. missing for 10: documentation of webhook registration and payload schema, delivery semantics (signing, retries), worked examples of webhook-triggered remediation or agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations for issues coming from projects or Monitors.
